Input for the hack/substitute.sh self-test. SELFTEST_DEFINED=resolved.
Every case below renders byte-identically to `flux envsubst` except the single
line marked DIVERGENCE, which is substitute.sh's deliberate handling of an
undefined variable (Flux blanks it; see hack/substitute.sh header, point 3).
plain            ${SELFTEST_DEFINED}
escaped          $${SELFTEST_DEFINED}
escape-then-site $$${SELFTEST_DEFINED}
two-escapes      $$$${SELFTEST_DEFINED}
bare             $SELFTEST_DEFINED
lone-pair        $$
adjacent         a$${SELFTEST_DEFINED}b${SELFTEST_DEFINED}c
escaped-undef    $${SELFTEST_UNDEFINED}
DIVERGENCE undef ${SELFTEST_UNDEFINED}
trailing dollar  $
